entries.text: He that kidnaps a man, whether he sells him or he is found in his possession, he shall be put to death.

text.text: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
If a man be found stealing any of his brethren of the children of Israel, and maketh merchandise of him, or selleth him; then that thief shall die; and thou shalt put evil away from among you.
